gap: No result ChatGPT got says that the backup-camera input on a portable CarPlay screen expects the screen maker's own camera signal (ESSGOO's portable screens are sold with an AHD rear camera, while ESSGOO's own separate backup camera is a 720×480 NTSC AV-in camera, and Lamtto writes that 'Only original or compatible cameras are supported'). A shopper who adds a spare or third-party camera can get no picture even when the reverse-light trigger wire is connected correctly.
standout_why: I compared gearnudge.com (checklist), carcody.com (5 Best CarPlay Backup Cameras) and cartechtalk.com (Best Portable CarPlay Screen With Backup Camera). Gearnudge and CarCody already explain the reverse-light power and trigger wire and the automatic switch to the camera when you shift into reverse. CarCody also says that 'An HD camera will not automatically produce an HD picture on a standard-definition input', but it says this about in-dash receivers, and it never mentions AHD or a portable screen's own camera port. Gearnudge mentions only an 'RCA video input'. Cartechtalk gives no signal format or connector. The signal-format point is therefore partly covered, and only for head units.
decides: It confirms that the safe pick is a portable screen sold with its own rear camera, as ChatGPT's 'make sure the package includes the rear camera' advice says. It also adds the reason: the port is matched to a signal format, so a separately bought camera may not work. And the screen switches automatically only after the camera's red trigger wire is spliced into the reverse-light positive. That splice is the install step that decides whether the setup works at all.

findings.label: How the reverse view is triggered on a portable CarPlay screen (maker's install guide)
findings.value: The camera's red trigger wire goes to the reverse light's positive terminal. 'The reverse light only activates when the car is in reverse gear'. If the rear view stays on all the time, the cause is 'Incorrect wiring of the reverse trigger wire'.
findings.source_title: Why Is My Reverse Camera Not Showing? (Easy Fix Guide) - Lamtto
findings.note: Lamtto is a maker of portable CarPlay screens. The article is dated 2026-04-30. Quotes are taken from its installation and troubleshooting steps.

findings.label: Which cameras the port accepts (maker's guide)
findings.value: 'Only original or compatible cameras are supported'. The camera plugs into the AV input port under the screen.
findings.source_title: Why Is My Reverse Camera Not Showing? (Easy Fix Guide) - Lamtto
findings.note: The page also mentions AHD extension cables. It does not explain the AHD vs CVBS difference.
